info.title: fyrr HTTP API
info.description: The /v1/ routes of the reader (query, fetch, report, list) and of the writer (documents, delete). The version is that of the MCP contract the query and fetch bodies follow.

get.summary: List the namespaces the key may act in
get.description: Needs an API key with the `admin` or `list` role.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Keeps the names that start with it.

get.summary: Report a namespace's schema, settings, size and index state
get.description: Needs an API key with the `admin` or `list` role.

delete.summary: Delete a namespace and its data
delete.description: Needs an API key with the `admin` role.

post.summary: Search the namespace: the `search` tool as JSON
post.description: Needs an API key with the `read` role, or an OIDC user.

post.summary: Fetch documents of the namespace: the `fetch` tool as JSON
post.description: Needs an API key with the `read` role, or an OIDC user.

post.summary: Upsert, patch and delete documents, all or none
post.description: Needs an API key with the `write` role.

Error.description: An error: an HTTP status and `{"error":"<code>"}`; docs/http-api.md lists the codes.

DeleteNamespaceRequest.description: The body of `DELETE /v1/namespaces/{namespace}`: the name, repeated.

QueryRequest.description:
The body of `POST /v1/namespaces/{namespace}/query`: the arguments of the
`search` tool and two members that are no tool arguments.

query.description: Query text, 1-4096 UTF-8 bytes. Omit only for a filter-only listing with order=updated_at or order_by.

queries.description: Alternative to query: 2–16 queries, sharing filters and deadline.

vector.description: Query vector of the namespace's dimensions, instead of an embedding of query. Without query the search is dense only and makes no embedding call.

exact.description: Exact search: score every row that passes the filter and the caller's permissions instead of probing the index. Refused as invalid_argument when more rows pass than the bound of an exact search.

text_hits.description: Hits carrying text per query, before deduplication; default all.

excerpt_chars.description: Excerpt length in Unicode codepoints; default 1200; excerpt output only.

limit.description: Hits per query; default 50 for query, default/max 20 for queries. A listing takes up to 1000 less its offset.

offset.description: Documents a listing skips: only without query or queries, and offset plus limit is at most 1000.

order.description: Default relevance; updated_at sorts newest first, null dates last.

order_by.description:
Listing order without query or queries, instead of order: 1-4 keys, the first most significant.
Nulls sort first ascending and last descending; ties are broken by the document key.

attributes.description: Connector attributes; a hit matches every entry.

exclude.description: Documents to omit, e.g. ones already returned.

filter.description: Filter tree of `and`, `or`, `not` and comparisons; a hit also matches the arguments above.

fields.description: What a hit returns besides its document fields.

OutputMode.description: How much text a hit carries.

OrderKey.description:
A built-in field or a typed attribute of the namespace to sort by. The
reader refuses a field it does not know or whose values are not an orderable
scalar: the connector labels, an array or `bytes`.

AttributeFilter.description: Equality (one value) or IN (several values) on one connector attribute.

Filter.description:
A filter tree: `and` and `or` of one or more filters, `not` of one, or a
comparison of a field with a value. At most [`MAX_FILTER_NODES`] nodes in
[`MAX_FILTER_DEPTH`] levels. It is read from the request in one pass that
stops at the first bound it exceeds.

Comparison.description:
A field compared with a value; `in` and `not_in` take an array of values.
The reader checks the field and the value against the namespace's schema.

Op.description:
How a field is compared with a value. The last five test the elements of an
array attribute and apply to nothing else.

oneOf.description: The version the reader holds; a write acknowledged a moment ago may not show yet.
After a version check that started once the request arrived.

Consistency.description: How current the version is that a `query` or `fetch` answer is read from.

scores.description: Report the lexical score and the vector distance of each hit.

ReturnFields.description:
What a hit returns besides the document fields: the `fields` member of a
JSON `query` request. `include` names the attributes to return, `exclude`
the ones to leave out of all of them (an empty list leaves out none). The
vector of a row is returned only when `include` names `vector`.

FetchRequest.description:
The body of `POST /v1/namespaces/{namespace}/fetch`: the arguments of the
`fetch` tool and `consistency`, which is no tool argument.

documents.description: Ordered documents with individual record windows; alternative to other lookups.

uri.description: Exact canonical source URI, matched byte for byte after trimming whitespace.

window.description: A span of one record returned by search; needs source_id and root_id.

FetchDocument.description: One ordered fetch lookup and its optional record window.

revision.description: The hit's revision token; a changed record returns document_changed.

FetchWindow.description: A codepoint span of a record: start..end, or start with context on both sides.

settings.description: Part of the settings of a namespace that does not exist yet, laid over the process defaults.

upserts.description: Rows that replace the documents with their ids.

patches.description: Rows that write some attributes of a document that exists.

conditions.description:
From an id of the request to the filter that the stored document with
that id must meet for the change to apply. Needs the `admin` role.

id.description: The row's key in the namespace.

readers.description: `usr:<id>` or `grp:<id>`; ignored by an open namespace.

vector.description: The vector of the row's text, of the namespace's dimension.

schema.description: The typed attributes of the version, name to type.

settings.description: The namespace's settings, as its policy records them.

rows.description: Approximate live rows; `null` for a version published before contract 4.1.

logical_bytes.description: Approximate bytes of the data files of those rows, without indexes; `null` as `rows`.

first_published_at.description: When the namespace's first content publication was committed; `null` when that is not known.

unindexed.description: The data that an index of the version does not cover yet.

NamespaceReport.description:
What `GET /v1/namespaces/{namespace}` answers: what the reader holds of the
namespace's published version.

oneOf.description: An RFC 3339 string in requests, stored as UTC microseconds.
A UUID as 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal digits in requests, stored in 16 bytes.
Base64 in requests. Stored, never filtered, sorted or indexed.
A list of values of one scalar type, written `{"array": "string"}`.

ElementType.description: The type of the elements of an array: every scalar type but `bytes`.

dense_rq_bits.description: RaBitQ bits per dimension of the vector index.

dense_partition_rows.description: Target rows per partition of the vector index.

attributes.description:
The typed attributes the namespace declares when it is created. Each is
a nullable column with its own index from the first publication.

write_api.description:
Present: the namespace is written through the HTTP API and takes no
connector source. Fixed with the rest of the settings.

NamespaceSettings.description:
The index and retrieval settings a namespace is created with and keeps for
its life. The process configuration only supplies them when the namespace is
created; every reader and writer afterwards takes them from the namespace's
policy artifact, which each content manifest pins.

fingerprint.description:
Digest of the model settings and text transformation (prefix,
normalization) that keys the embedding cache.

EmbeddingIdentity.description: The embedding identity bound into envelopes and publications.

EmbeddingSettings.description: Vector-affecting settings recorded with a publication's model/dimensions.

EmbeddingApiStyle.description: Fixed protocol identity recorded in persisted embedding settings.

EmbeddingRoles.description:
Persisted role transformations accept future minor-version additions.
Configuration uses strict types at its TOML boundary.

with_position.description: Positional postings; false while there is no phrase scoring.

FtsSettings.description: FTS analyzer settings, part of the publication identity.

candidates.description: Authorized composed documents to rerank before the request limit.

weight.description: Logistic population-z score blend; 1 uses raw reranker order, 0 fusion order.

text_chars.description: Per-candidate text bound in characters; absent sends the whole record.

RerankSettings.description:
What of a reranker decides results: recorded in the namespace when it is
created. The endpoint, credential, spend caps and deadline stay process
configuration ([`RerankConfig`]). Persisted types accept the fields a newer
minor version adds, unlike their configuration counterparts.

text_attribute.description:
The key of a row that holds its text: embedded, full-text indexed and
returned as the content of the record. It is not a typed attribute and
not one of `attributes`.

open.description:
`false`: a row is readable by the reader tokens it names, and a row
that names none by nobody. `true`: every authenticated subject of the
deployment reads every row.

WriteApiSettings.description:
How a namespace written through the HTTP API stores and shows its rows. Fixed
for the life of the namespace.

Unindexed.description: `rows` and `logical_bytes` of the data that no index covers yet.

truncated.description: Set when the response budget trimmed text or hits (narrow or lower `limit`).

query_index.description: Winning query's zero-based index, present only for multi-query search.

SearchHit.description: One hit, in a deterministic total order.

Excerpt.description: A literal passage of the record; offsets are Unicode codepoints in the record text.

degraded.description: Lanes skipped by degradation (e.g. dense after a failed query embedding).

stale_version.description:
The answer comes from an older version than the serving head the
reader last read.

omitted_bytes.description: UTF-8 bytes omitted by clipping or the payload budget.

SchemaVersion.description: Contract schema version `<major>.<minor>`. Readers accept any minor of their major and reject other majors.

rerank_us.description: Rerank preparation and concurrent provider wait, separate from retrieval.

routing_strategy.description: Effective centroid route; mixed means different routes across index deltas.

routing_fallback.description: First optional routing failure across index deltas, never an I/O or auth error.

stage_us.description: Fixed stage names, microseconds; no query or identity labels.

stage_s3_requests.description: Requests and bytes on the same bounded stages.

filter_rows_scanned.description: Authorized rows inspected for this call's document counts, never cached.

lexical_candidates_fetched.description: Lexical candidates returned, including repeated fetches for cutoff ties.

lexical_tie_bound_hits.description: Unresolved lexical cutoff ties at the fixed fetch bound (zero or one).

dense_candidates_fetched.description: Dense candidates read, including repeated fetches for cutoff ties.

dense_tie_bound_hits.description: Unresolved dense cutoff ties at the fixed fetch bound (zero or one).

RoutingMethod.description: Effective routing used by this request's native vector indexes.

RoutingFallback.description: Bounded reasons for using exact centroid routing instead of RaBitQ.

document_changed.description: Single-lookup window status; list requests report status on each document.

window.description: Codepoint range served for a window, after the content limit.

document_changed.description: Per-document window status for a list request; changed records have no text.

FetchedDocument.description: A document with its records in order.

ServedWindow.description: The span a window request returned.

patched.description: Present when the request has patches.

skipped.description: The patches and conditional changes that did not apply; present when the request has any.

WriteResponse.description: What a write answers: the changes that applied.

ErrorBody.description:
The body of an error answer of the reader and of the write route. The
namespace deletion answers a SCIM error instead.
